decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture (delete as appropriate)


REASON: To ensure the development integrates with the host building and surrounding area.

<p>Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e. water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80- 150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.&nbsp;<br><br></p><p>REASON: To promote sustainable water management and prevent increased surface water runoff into the local network.</p>

<p>A scheme for the provision and implementation of flood resilient and resistant construction details and measures for the site and in the basement against surface water (overland flow) flood risk shall be submitted to and agreed, in writing with the LPA in consultation with the LLFA prior to the construction of the measures. The scheme shall be carried out in its entirety before the basement is occupied and; constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice and current best practice where applicable.<br><br>REASON:&nbsp;To mitigate the risks of surface water flooding and ensure the long-term structural safety and habitability of the basement.</p>

<p>Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before the relevant work is commenced. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp;</p><p>a) 1:20 drawings and 1:5 sections of the proposed windows (including frame/profile details of 12–14mm) and doors and doors&nbsp;</p><p>b) Full details of the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the buildings, including glazing </p><p>c) Full details of&nbsp;front boundary treatment.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area</p><div><br></div>
description: Erection of part single, part two-storey ground floor and first floor rear extension, with installation of rear rooflight; front basement level extension, with installation of new door and sidelight window to front basement level; and front landscaping and associated works.
